set.name: Writing Algebraic Expressions

criteria: 能说出移项的依据
能解 ax+b=cx+d 型方程
set.description: 把含未知数的项移到一边、常数项移到另一边（移项要变号），再合并同类项、系数化为 1。

set.nameZh: 移项与合并同类项解方程

set.reason: Writing the equation requires expressing each quantity in terms of the chosen unknown.
set.scope: expressing quantities to form the equation

set.reason: The explicit linear-modeling cycle includes solving the resulting linear equation. This does not make named transposition the only permissible reasoning.
set.scope: the solve step of the modeling process

set.reason: The criterion explicitly computes the parenthesized subexpression first, containing the same parentheses priority convention as the endpoint.
set.scope: evaluating parentheses first

set.reason: The general mixed-expression repertoire includes unlike-denominator addition/subtraction stages; these are scoped arithmetic components.
set.scope: mixed expressions with unlike denominators

set.reason: The integer-divisor case provides familiar reciprocal-rule practice. A general fraction-divisor rule can instead be derived directly by equalizing units or solving the defining multiplication relation; Gemini's customary first-lesson order does not make that earlier special-case procedure a necessary step.
set.scope: extending the reciprocal rule to fractional divisors

set.reason: The unit-whole criterion interprets a fractional part of the whole and then inverts that relation. Fraction-of-a-quantity modeling is necessary, without requiring the endpoint's preferred arithmetic implementation.
set.scope: identifying the unit whole in the fraction relation

set.reason: The target writes and evaluates a fractional division expression, containing the division-by-fraction operation.
set.scope: computing the division expression
